title.en: The number of elements equal to the maximum

description.zh:
序列由整數組成，並以數字 0 結尾。確定該序列中有多少個元素等於其最大元素。

Java 注意： 輸入以 0 結束時不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；可能出現小數結果時使用 double。
description.en:
A sequence consists of integer numbers and ends with the number 0. Determine how many elements of this sequence are equal to its largest element.

Java note: Do not include a terminating zero in the sequence. Use double when the result may be fractional.

hint.zh: 輸入以 0 結束時不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；可能出現小數結果時使用 double。
hint.en: Do not include a terminating zero in the sequence. Use double when the result may be fractional.
